transcript.title: Opening
transcript.text: Good morning Rushil Bhatia. Here is your daily news for Saturday, August 22. In today's briefing: top headlines, bhopal and madhya pradesh, business and markets, money, tax and personal finance, science and technology, development and policy, across india, around the world. Let's begin.

transcript.title: Top headlines
transcript.text: First, the stories leading the news this morning. Sugar output may dip 11 percent , says govt, rules out ethanol diversion impact on prices. Says Drop Not Due To Ethanol Diversion Gen Alpha protests mirror government report: Big gaps in school education. Issues Neither Unique To Any Region, Nor Universal Neeraj Chopra finishes 2nd in Lausanne Diamond League javelin event. Rumesh Tharanga Pathirage edged Neeraj Chopra by just nine centimetres to beat him for the third time this season at the Lausanne Diamond League. Chopra briefly led with an 88.05m second-round throw, but Pathirage responded with 88.14m. Chopra settled for silver, while Anderson Peters took third, with the result also boosting Chopra's hopes of reaching the Diamond League Final. PLP to PLI, reform express at full speed, says PM Modi. 'If India's Future Is Secure, World's Is Too' Government orders Google to shut down hundreds of Firebase accounts over scam misuse. Indian authorities ordered Google to close hundreds of Firebase accounts. These accounts were exploited by criminals for banking scams and malware. Officials found a pattern of impersonating major banks to defraud users. The Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre issued multiple notices for account removals. Zuckerberg buys Gothic castle in Ireland, Meta's international HQ, for $35 mn. Meta CEO, Mark Zuckerberg, and his wife, Priscilla Chan, have acquired the historic Strancally Castle, a stunning Gothic mansion set on an expansive estate in Ireland. This remarkable property will serve as their home base during visits to the nation, which is significant due to Meta's international headquarters being located there. The couple is excited about the opportunity to preserve and nurture this piece of history. Rashtrapati Bhavan hints at Bangladesh PM Tarique Rahman's visit, retracts. NEW DELHI: India and Bangladesh remain in talks about PM Tarique Rahman's Delhi visit but the dates aren't locked in, diplomatic sources said on Friday. US seized California island ranch after $4m offer; jury awarded family $12.7m. A federal jury awarded a California family $12.7 million for their Santa Cruz Island ranch. The government had seized the 6,300-acre property using eminent domain in 1996. This verdict concluded a decades-long property dispute between park officials and the Gherini family. The family's ancestors had owned part of the island since the late 19th century. In 2016, Burt's Bees co-founder gave US 87,500 acres; now it's a monument. Roxanne Quimby, the visionary behind Burt's Bees, initially embraced a life of artistic expression and sustainability before venturing into the business world. After partnering with Burt Shavitz, they created a beloved range of beeswax products. Motivated by her love for nature, Quimby invested her earnings into the conservation of Maine's forests, acquiring extensive land despite pushback from logging interests. How Chile telescope accidentally captured a missing link in astronomy. An unfinished observatory in Chile has captured dense gas clouds from a dying star. These expelled clouds are now blending back into the Milky Way galaxy. This breakthrough demonstrates how stellar elements are recycled for future celestial bodies. The observatory, MOTHRA, achieved this during calibration tests in November 2025. 105, not out? SC orders release of murder convict. Born in 1920 when Congress had launched the non-cooperation movement against the British, Rasik Mandal got his freedom as a 105-year-old life convict Friday after SC ordered the centenarian should spend his remaining days with his family. 2 killed after small plane crashes in Croatia. Two people were found dead late Friday after a small plane flying from the Czech Republic crashed in the mountains of Paklenica National Park, about 60 kilometres northeast of the coastal city of Zadar, news agency AP reported citing Croatian authorities said.

Tomato prices in Indore's wholesale market have fallen sharply to rupees 3-5 per kg amid bumper production and rising arrivals from Andhra Pradesh, Karnataka and Maharashtra. The Indian rupee pared initial gains and settled on a flat note, higher by just 3 paise at 95.71 (provisional) against the US dollar on Friday, as the support from a weak dollar was negated by continued geopolitical tensions. Rupee traded flat to positive on a weak dollar and a positive tone in the domestic markets. Indian shares fluctuated before ending little changed on Friday as investors saw the U.S. Treasury's bond buyback move as a temporary fix rather than a structural solution to rising yields. Sebi's model draws on the experience of mutual fund distributors, who have helped expand mutual fund penetration beyond major urban centres. When Apollo 16 astronaut left family photo on Moon. In 1972, Apollo 16 astronaut Charles Duke left a framed photo of his wife and two sons on the Moon, along with a touching message identifying his family as being "from Planet Earth," creating one of the most personal and emotional mementos ever left on the lunar surface. Indian couples say 'I do' off the beaten path. Indian couples are increasingly moving away from established wedding destinations such as Goa, Delhi and Mumbai, opting instead for quieter, scenic locations in smaller cities and towns. Shares of Saatvik Green Energy rose 4.5 percent to rupees 419 after winning a rupees 190 crore solar PV module order, marking its largest gain in over a month. The S and P 500 and Dow Jones futures each gained 0.3 percent , while Nasdaq-100 futures increased 0.6 percent , despite concerns over inflation and national debt.
